vision.name: Black Flowing Drill
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: [Trait:Saiyan]: Use at the start of your Rejuvenation Step. Rejuvenate a Styled [Defense] card from your discard pile.
[Instant] POWER: Use after your effect discards a card from your opponent's hand. Banish the top card of your opponent's discard pile.
vision.note: landscape Drill layout; Set 18 uses a new blue 'C' crest as set symbol; inline icon zoomed: green S badge (Saiyan); the shield icon is the Defense icon; no Endurance badge
